SECTION_1_CONTENT: Welcome to Saayam For All (“Saayam”, “we”, “our”, or “us”). Saayam is a nonprofit platform designed to connect individuals seeking assistance (“Requesters”) with volunteers willing to provide support (“Volunteers”). By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms and Conditions (“Terms”). If you do not agree, you should not use the Platform.
SECTION_2_CONTENT: Saayam For All operates solely as a technology platform that facilitates connections between users. Saayam does not assign, manage, supervise, or control volunteer activities. All engagements are voluntary and initiated at the discretion of users based on their interests, availability, and judgment. Saayam is not a party to any interaction, agreement, or arrangement between users and does not guarantee the completion, quality, or outcome of any assistance.
SECTION_3_CONTENT: Volunteers are not obligated to accept or complete any request. Participation is entirely voluntary and based on individual availability, interest, and discretion. Once a volunteer chooses to engage with a request, they are encouraged—but not legally required—to act responsibly, communicate clearly, and maintain respectful conduct.
SECTION_4_CONTENT: The Platform may suggest or display requests to volunteers based on categories, preferences, or relevant skills. All decisions to engage with a request are made independently by users. Saayam does not guarantee matches, availability of volunteers, or fulfillment of requests.
SECTION_5_CONTENT: Saayam does not supervise, control, or assume responsibility for interactions that occur between users outside the Platform. Users are solely responsible for evaluating the suitability, reliability, and safety of any interaction. Saayam strongly encourages users to exercise judgment and take appropriate precautions during both online and in-person engagements.
SECTION_6_CONTENT: Users agree not to: Engage in unlawful, harmful, or fraudulent activities; Harass, abuse, or harm other users; Misrepresent identity or intentions. Saayam reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to remove content, suspend accounts, or restrict access if user behavior violates these Terms or poses risks to others or the organization.
SECTION_7_CONTENT: Saayam collects and processes user data in accordance with its <1>Privacy Policy</1>. While reasonable safeguards are implemented to protect personal information, no system can guarantee absolute security. Users acknowledge that they share information at their own risk.
SECTION_8_CONTENT: Saayam does not tolerate discrimination based on race, gender, religion, nationality, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
SECTION_9_CONTENT: All users are expected to act with respect, empathy, and integrity. Harassment, discrimination, exploitation, or harmful conduct toward any individual will not be tolerated.
SECTION_10_CONTENT: Saayam may provide general guidelines, best practices, or informational resources to support safe and respectful interactions on the Platform. However, Saayam does not provide formal training, supervision, or oversight of volunteer activities.
